verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a CDP could plausibly ship autonomous background automations or agents. However, the evidence only shows an assistant that "suggests the logic to use" from a described goal, plus marketing taglines such as "One Agent across connected workflows." Nothing documents user-configured automations that run unattended in the background, so the story is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
